name: Legendary Personage
body:
Your presence grows as you continue to straddle the line between being a leader and a reckoning force.

Prerequisite(s): 3rd level in both marshal and vigilante classes, inspire action, renown (or obscurity) social talent, unshakeable, and 4 skill ranks in Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, and Sense Motive.

Benefit: Your marshal and vigilante class levels stack together for the purpose of determining your total daily uses of inspire action, the effectiveness of unshakeable, and the distance limit from a community you have gained renown or obscurity in with the renown or obscurity social talent. This does not change your effective class levels for any other aspects.

You also stack your marshal and vigilante class levels together to determine your effective marshal and vigilante levels for the purposes of meeting the prerequisites of any social talent that has renown or obscurity as a prerequisite and feats.
